limits: Whole-binary comparison, not isolated attribution of Phase78 optimizations.
Both controls are historical draft binaries bound by SHA256, not immutable source snapshots.
Other Qwen3.5 sizes only; non-Qwen architectures and long-context cases remain unmeasured.
MXFP8 is not FP8 outer-vector and does not exercise ID71. Standard gfx1030 CLI rejects Qwen embedded FP8 GGUF; Gemma mixed GGUF uses a different accepted path.
Only 1 warmup and 3 measured samples per arm; no statistical significance or release performance gate claimed.
Audit equality covers recorded fields/counts, not a full per-kernel profiler trace.
No new logits oracle or physical DRAM bandwidth/offload monitor was run.
